recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. The current specification preserves the required FHIR-12579 correction, and further source edits would only duplicate or disturb later applied search-example clarifications.
issue_request: FHIR-12579 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core search correction raised against DSTU2. It asked that the Advanced filtering example on the search page use the Observation code search parameter instead of the invalid name parameter for the LOINC token example.
initial_application: The issue appears to have been applied by svn @11018, represented in git as 679271e1fb51a6bcfb0b8d0d3ac3a1220b8fc61c, whose message is "#12579 - fix typo" and whose patch changes the affected source/search.html example from Observation?name=http://loinc.org|1234-5 to Observation?code=http://loinc.org|1234-5.
additional_context: The current build-scope search narrative is source/search.html. Later Applied issue FHIR-45306 and commit 1d29a98d3d2f8e140eb23843984a6f2177fbe645 clarified the same Advanced filtering examples by changing the patient reference portion from subject.name to patient.name, but did not revert the FHIR-12579 code-parameter correction. Direct community searches for FHIR-12579 found no Zulip or Confluence evidence that changes the Jira/source conclusion.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current Advanced filtering example already uses code=http://loinc.org|1234-5 in both the ordinary search URL and the _filter expression, and the stale name-parameter form from the issue request is absent from the active search sources checked.
